correctness.rationale: For \(N_\omega(s,t)=\max\{|s|,|t|\}+\omega\min\{|s|,|t|\}\), the absolute-norm comparison bound at Gao exponent two gives \(c'_{NJ}\ge(M_1M_2)^{-2}\). On \(0\le t\le1/2\), direct Cauchy--Schwarz gives \(M_1=\sqrt{1+\omega^2}\). With \(u=t/(1-t)\), differentiating \(\sqrt{1+u^2}/(1+\omega u)\) shows \(M_2=\max\{1,\sqrt2/(1+\omega)\}\). Independent symbolic substitution of the two proposed unit-vector pairs gives the two branch values exactly, and their equality reduces to \(\omega=\sqrt2-1\).
